verdict.rationale: AiPrise documents its own API for building custom verification workflows and running screening, which lets the product be driven programmatically without its hosted UI. Nothing shows a CLI, CI integration, or headless automation mode, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404. missing for 10: CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline integration docs, API key/automation auth guidance, published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Build fully custom verification workflows using AiPrise APIs for maximum control and flexibility.
Screen adverse media, PEPs, sanctions, and watchlists in real time - all through one API.
